rv.q: The Zeffirelli “Bohème” has persisted and shows no signs of growing old.
Puccini’s melodies soared, and prayers were sung above a perfectly balanced and paced performance laden with emotion.
Fortunately, the Met Opera's current cast, which opened the revival on Oct. 21, 2025, is the former and might just be the best I have seen in quite some time.

cn.t: Zeffirelli's iconic 1981 production still dazzles with its grand spectacle, particularly the beloved Café Momus scene. New stars Grigoryan and De Tommaso lead a strong cast in the Met's perennial warhorse.
